report.answer_text:
The two-part "Italy" episode was filmed on location in the town of Anguillara Sabazia outside of Rome[1]. Filming took place in July 2000. The episodes were the season 5 premiere.
Anguillara Sabazia is a small fisherman's village on Lake Bracciano, about 45 minutes drive NW from Rome[2]. The lake is visible in the background for much of the episode. Aunt Coletta's house is at the edge of Lake Bracciano, and the lake shows behind the gelateria's outside tables.[3]
Because it was shot on location, it was filmed single-camera, unlike the series' usual multi-camera setup[4].
